app.title: MyImageSearch — Image search
settings.title: Search settings
settings.searchMethodsHint: These searches use the text in the search box.
settings.regexpHint: Applies to the next filename, tag or style group search.
settings.savedQueryHint: Created after a search. Copy and save it to repeat the search.
settings.actualColumns: Currently using {count} columns to fit this screen.
search.running: Searching images. A large collection may take longer.
results.browseHint: Images load at your scroll position. Matching images count the selected categories; collection candidates count all images registered for this model.
results.searchHint: Up to {count} search candidates. Search matches are the candidates remaining after category filtering.
results.emptyBrowseHint: Look for more matching images or change image categories in the menu.
results.emptySearchHint: Try different search text or filters in the menu.
pagination.label: Collection pages
selection.help: Click an image to enlarge it. Choose Select to select images instead. Shift-click selects a range, and Select all selects up to the first 1,024 images. Close clears the selection and returns to browsing.
selection.searchLimit: Use up to 64 images for search and 1,024 for saving.
selection.limit: Select up to 1,024 images at once. Clear some selections and try again.
download.selectedHint: Save the selected images together in one ZIP file.
download.defaultHint: With no selection, save up to the first 1,024 images matching the current search and categories.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Check your connection and search settings, then try again.
errors.noModels: No search models are available. Create an index and try again.
errors.uploadTooLarge: The search image must be 64 MiB or smaller. Resize it and try again.
errors.selectionLimit: Save up to 1,024 images at once.
errors.imageSearchLimit: Use up to 64 images for a search. Select fewer images.
errors.downloadFailed: Images could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalidInput: Check your input. Update the search settings or number of selected images and try again.
errors.resourceLimit: A resource limit was reached. Use smaller images or select fewer images.
errors.notFound: The image or data was not found. Try another image.
errors.serverError: The server could not complete the request. Wait a moment and try again.
download.preparing: Preparing your ZIP file. A large batch may take longer.
download.startedSkipped: Started downloading {count} images. {skipped} images could not be retrieved.
errors.invalid_input: Check your input. Update the search settings or number of selected images and try again.
errors.invalid_query: This saved query could not be read. Copy the complete query and use the same model that created it.
errors.invalid_pattern: The regular expression is invalid or too slow. Simplify it and try again.
errors.invalid_model_or_image: This model or image is unavailable. Check your selection and try again.
errors.resource_limit: A resource limit was reached. Use smaller images or select fewer images.
errors.request_too_large: A resource limit was reached. Use smaller images or select fewer images.
errors.download_busy: Another ZIP file is being prepared. Try again when it finishes.
errors.download_expired: This download expired. Select Save again to prepare a new file.
results.findMoreHint: Checks a limited batch of the next candidates each time.
results.categoriesRequired: Select at least one image category in the menu.
selection.helpTitle: How to select and save images
search.imageHelp: Use Image search in the top bar to choose an image file to search with. If images are selected, it searches using those images.
download.zipHint: Images will be combined in one ZIP file.
